The generator inside qrcode.js is Kazuhiko Arase's QRCode for JavaScript
(http://www.d-project.com/), MIT, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase.
QR Code is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.

GifOS inlines classic scripts. jQuery is not shipped — QRCode.js has no
dependency on it. The last payload is saved privately. Press Invite to show
the same code in a meeting. Upstream is a library with a demo page, not an
app: this directory is the wrap.
